metadata.title: Accessibility Statement | KR8 DIGITALS
metadata.description: Accessibility engineering standards and feedback channel for the KR8 DIGITALS website.

STANDARDS.title: Keyboard-Operable Controls & Skip Links
STANDARDS.body: Every interactive drawer, lightbox, tab list, and form control on this platform is engineered for full keyboard navigation, visible focus states, Escape-to-dismiss behavior, and a top-of-page Skip to Content link.

STANDARDS.title: High-Contrast Legibility Across Devices
STANDARDS.body: Display headlines, body copy, and interactive buttons are paired against deep obsidian surfaces to maintain strong visual contrast on indoor and outdoor mobile screens, with scalable fluid typography up to 200% zoom.

STANDARDS.title: Reduced-Motion Support & Captioned Cuts
STANDARDS.body: System prefers-reduced-motion settings are respected across transitions, hero cinema plates include pause controls, and vertical video stories incorporate burned-in captions so narratives remain legible without audio.

STANDARDS.title: Report Any Barrier Directly
STANDARDS.body: If any page, media element, or form creates a barrier with your screen reader or assistive device, email kr8digitals01@gmail.com with the page URL and our engineering team will remediate it promptly.

WAYS.label: Teach
WAYS.line: Bring a craft into the free training.
WAYS.body: If you do the work, you can teach it. A partner who teaches supplies a track, a practitioner to run it and a standard for the work — we supply the students, the structure and the logistics. Motionverse teaches graphic design; CHIGOMA teaches video editing; Next Gen Scholars teaches the academic door.
gives: A track in the free training
A brief the students build against
WAYS.imageAlt: Design work by Motionverse, a co-founding partner

WAYS.label: Fund
WAYS.line: Pay for the thing that has no invoice.
WAYS.body: Training is free, which means somebody pays for the room, the data, the equipment and the people teaching. Funding is named and it is specific: a cohort, a track, a set of laptops, a Mindset Shift edition. You get the record of what it paid for.
WAYS.imageAlt: A learner-facing programme site built by KR8 Digitals

WAYS.label: Hire
WAYS.line: Take our people on when they are ready.
WAYS.body: The most useful thing a partner can do is hire. We will tell you who is ready, show you their work and their verification record, and you interview them like anyone else. No placement fee. The point is that the training ends in work.
WAYS.imageAlt: Engineers, designers, and editors collaborating inside the KR8 Digitals talent pipeline

WAYS.label: Host
WAYS.body: A hall for a cohort, a venue for Mindset Shift, a site for a shoot, connectivity for a class. If you have a space that sits empty when it could be full of people learning, that is a partnership.
gives: A location or production space for a shoot
